subject.title: feat(web): unify the app on a paper & ember design language

question: Should paper-and-ember become ClickClack’s canonical light and dark web identity?
rationale: The patch is technically sound and well-proven, but choosing a product-wide palette and identity gradient is a subjective product decision that tests cannot resolve.

options.title: Accept paper and ember
options.body: Approve the demonstrated warm identity, remove the changelog lines, and merge after the normal exact-head gates pass.

options.title: Request palette revision
options.body: Keep the token architecture and proxy fix but request specific color or contrast adjustments before accepting the visual direction.

options.title: Retain current identity
options.body: Decline the visual retheme and separate the independently useful Vite WebSocket fix into a narrow PR.

recommendation.title: Accept paper and ember
recommendation.body: Approve the demonstrated warm identity, remove the changelog lines, and merge after the normal exact-head gates pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The original current-main theme, layout, Vite proxy, and embedded web setup all trace to Peter’s v0.1.0 preparation commit.
